name: UNSW President and Vice-Chancellor's Equity Scholarship
summary: Yearly equity scholarship for commencing UNSW undergraduate or postgraduate students in low-SES circumstances.
key: $5,000 per annum for the minimum duration of program.
how: Apply through UAC for an Equity Scholarship (ES) or EAS; Gateway applicants are considered automatically
catches: 2027 rounds: EAS via UAC by 19 Nov 2026, ES by 10 Dec 2026, with later January and February rounds; offers made through to March 2027
Competitive; meeting the criteria does not guarantee an award
